mapper.sql: t.id, t.task_no, t.task_name, t.priority, t.status, t.plan_start_time, t.plan_end_time, t.actual_start_time, t.actual_end_time, t.drone_id, t.drone_code, t.pilot_id, t.pilot_name, t.route_info, t.description, t.create_by, t.create_by_name, t.route_id, t.takeoff_lng, t.takeoff_lat, t.takeoff_name, t.evidence_state, t.evidence_type, t.evidence_at, t.create_time, t.update_time

where.if: AND (t.task_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.task_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM `task` t
ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `task` t
SELECT FROM `task` t WHERE t.task_no = #{taskNo} LIMIT 1
SELECT MAX(task_no) FROM `task` WHERE task_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `task` (task_no, task_name, priority, status, plan_start_time, plan_end_time, route_info, description, route_id, route_snapshot, takeoff_lng, takeoff_lat, takeoff_name, create_by, create_by_name) VALUES (#{taskNo}, #{taskName}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{planStartTime}, #{planEndTime}, #{routeInfo}, #{description}, #{routeId}, #{routeSnapshot}, #{takeoffLng}, #{takeoffLat}, #{takeoffName}, #{createBy}, #{createByName})
mapper.update: UPDATE `task` SET pilot_id = #{pilotId}, pilot_name = #{pilotName}, drone_id = #{droneId}, drone_code = #{droneCode}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{taskId}
UPDATE `task` SET status = 'executing', actual_start_time = #{actualStartTime}, evidence_state = 'declared' WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 'dispatched'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `task` WHERE pilot_id = #{pilotId} AND status IN ('dispatched', 'executing')

SELECT DISTINCT u.id FROM `user` u JOIN user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN `role` r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 JOIN role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id JOIN permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE u.status = '1' AND p.code = #{permissionCode} ORDER BY u.id

SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS id, CONCAT(u.name, ' · ', u.username) AS label FROM `user` u JOIN user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN `role` r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 WHERE u.status = '1' AND r.code = 'pilot' ORDER BY u.id
SELECT d.id AS id, CONCAT(d.code, ' · ', d.name) AS label FROM `drone` d WHERE d.status = 'idle' ORDER BY d.code
SELECT FROM `task` t WHERE t.status = 'executing' ORDER BY t.actual_start_time, t.id
SELECT FROM `task` t WHERE t.drone_id = #{droneId} AND t.status = 'executing' ORDER BY t.actual_start_time DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM `task` t WHERE t.status = 'executing' AND t.evidence_state = 'declared' AND t.actual_start_time IS NOT NULL AND t.actual_start_time < #{deadline} ORDER BY t.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE `task` SET evidence_state = 'stale' WHERE id = #{taskId} AND evidence_state = 'declared'
